entries.title: Join us for a virtual event: Speak up, West Virginia!
entries.summary: Join reporters and editors from Mountain State Spotlight and other community members for a guided roundtable discussion about what issues are most important for you this election season.
entries.content:
Join reporters and editors from Mountain State Spotlight on Thursday, April 30, from 12 – 1 p.m. for a virtual discussion around what voters like you want candidates to be talking about as they campaign this election season.

This event is free, but spots are limited. Click here to reserve your spot!

Election season is underway, and that means candidates will be out vying for your vote.

We want you to help guide Mountain State Spotlight’s election coverage.

What do you want the candidates to be discussing as they ask for your vote? We want to hear from you!

Here are the key details:

What: Guided community discussion around what matters to YOU this election

When: Thursday, April 30, 12 pm – 1 pm
entries.author: Tyler Dedrick
